notes: cpu = math_gen.c (single-threaded; FND-009 big-integer coefficients, 128-bit accumulation when the inputs fit int64 and the bound holds); cuda = math_gen_gpu.cu (one work item per output coefficient or per point; device runs only); duckdb = GROUP BY counts and HUGEINT power sums; python = dict polynomials with Fractions (the explicit products).

A power's need is checked for its largest step before the first product (support growth, coefficient pairs, intermediate bytes); a refused power records that need. The histogram is the only pass over the rows.

thresholds.grid: convolution power of a 1024-value support (2^24 pairs per product)
